**Group:** Diatoms  ·  **Optics:** low-mag

## Defining characteristics

A low-magnification morphotype class originally described as 'diatom_chain_spikes' but most likely belonging to a species or complex of Chaetoceros. This morphotype has thicker setae and appears to have more than two setae per cell. Key features: Thick setae, thin chained cells.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **diatom_chain_2** | Morphotype 2 has spiral chains (helical). |
| **diatom_chain_3** | Morphotypes 3 are straight chains without thick setae. |
